classes.name: ThingsModelFactoryTest

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ThingsModelFactory class is immutable.

methods.description: Tests creation of Features object from a JSON object with a valid feature Id.

methods.name: fromJsonOfEmptyArrayStringFailsWithException
